official_quiz.q: Why did Lady Kou tell the judge the travelers killed her husband?
choices: She was angry with the travelers.
She wanted to see the travelers again.
She hoped to steal from the travelers.
official_quiz.q_zh: 寇夫人为什么告诉法官是旅行者杀了她的丈夫？
choices_zh: 她想再次见到那些旅行者。
她希望从旅行者那里偷东西。

official_quiz.q_zh: 法官为什么倒吸一口气？
choices_zh: 他看到了一个巨大的脚。
